SELECT cr.room_id, cr.type,
mp.code AS other_code, mp.id AS other_id, mp.rating AS other_rating, mp.path AS other_profile_image,
p.code AS product_code, p.title AS product_title, p.price AS product_price, p.thumbnail AS product_thumbnail,
cm.message_code, cm.sender_code, cm.message, cm.created_at FROM CHAT_ROOM cr
JOIN ( SELECT m.code, m.id, i.path, m.rating FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m LEFT JOIN IMAGES i ON m.code = i.target_code AND i.TYPE = 'profile' ) AS mp ON mp.code = #{otherMemberCode}
LEFT JOIN MARKET_PRODUCT p ON cr.type = 'DEAL' AND p.code = cr.target_code
LEFT JOIN CHAT_MESSAGE cm ON cm.room_code = cr.code WHERE cr.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY cm.created_at ASC
